question: Which of the following is the third largest ocean in the world and is present on the southern side of Asia?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indian Ocean**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Indian Ocean** is the third largest ocean in the world.
 
• It is bounded by Asia to the north, Africa to the west, Australia to the east, and the Southern Ocean to the south.
 
• The Indian Ocean covers approximately 20% of the Earth's water surface.
 
• It is an important route for international trade, especially for oil and petroleum products.
 
• The Indian Ocean is known for its unique marine biodiversity and significant climatic influence on the surrounding regions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Indian Ocean is the warmest ocean in the world, which affects the monsoon weather patterns in the region.
 
• It is home to several significant ports and harbors, including Mumbai, Colombo, and Durban.
 
• The ocean plays a crucial role in regulating the Earth’s climate and weather systems.
 
• It is also rich in mineral resources, including offshore oil and gas reserves.
 
• Several island nations, including the Maldives, Seychelles, and Mauritius, are located in the Indian Ocean.
